name: Tao Yao
role: heroine; playful challenger who is secretly in love
anchors: two buns with long red ribbons
crimson peach-blossom mark on the forehead
silhouette: slim; the two buns and trailing ribbons read in silhouette
handedness: right-handed: her sword is always in her RIGHT hand

props.sword: slim straight jian, silver blade, red tassel on the pommel

voice.accent: standard Mandarin; gate every take against an approved anchor line
voice.notes: bright and teasing, a light breath at line ends

acting: quick, light, teasing; tilts her head before she attacks; slow blink when tender
